(1) the Entity-Query Graph is an effective representation for capturing the semantic structure of search logs; (2) the Entity- Query Graph enables the identification of search queries that users are likely to perform in the future; (3) the proposed approach can anticipate user information needs in real time and with high accuracy; and (4) the approach can also be used to anticipate information needs of groups of users.
